tests.name: Azure DevOps work items > reads a pull request's changed files, renames included, and every human thread with nested replies, open ones first

tests.why: changed: inline thread folds after three comments and opens to four

tests.why: changed: asserts no Comments tab and that the thread content it held now shows inline

tests: tests/e2e/app.spec.ts::when nothing blocks a pull request, the overview says so in one quiet line, shows each reviewer once with required on the reviewer, You for the signed-in person, initials when a photo fails, and work items last
findings.note: an existing, unchanged browser test pins the Overview's section headings and broke when the new Discussion section was added; it is a pass-to-pass Playwright guard, so the gate's Vitest fail-on-base run would neither see nor need it

notes: Most MUSTs are UI behaviour checked only by Playwright tests; Vitest coverage is limited to two data-shape changes (author id, blocker pane target). The finding's test is not in the map because the branch did not change it. Report found as the final message in pr-threads-review1.jsonl.
